testing-code-study.title: Taking our code editor to a second site
testing-code-study.description: CodeStudy was built for Perpetual Education lessons. How hard is it to run somewhere else? This entry is the live experiment.
testing-code-study.summary: A portability trial of CodeStudy, the live code editor from Perpetual Education lessons - mounted and themed on this site, with an honest friction log. The examples in the entry are the test running.

kitchen-sink.title: The kitchen sink
kitchen-sink.description: Every module a journal entry can use, in one entry - the living outline new entries copy their shapes from.
kitchen-sink.summary: Every module a journal entry can use, in order. New entries start by copying shapes from this page, and it doubles as the style-guide surface where the entry template gets checked against theme changes.

new-website-direction.title: A new direction for this website
new-website-direction.description: What this site is now, why it works the way it does, and the kind of writing that will land here.
new-website-direction.summary: I got along without a "portfolio" for a long time! Sometimes landing a cool job with a comically simple 1-pager. But it's time! So, I'll do what I have all my students do - and design a system that does its job.

portfolio-first-look.title: A first look at my new portfolio structure
portfolio-first-look.description: A video walkthrough of how this site is put together - the timeline, the weights, the theme system, and why.
portfolio-first-look.summary: After spending years helping other people design and build their portfolios, it's my turn! How am I going to tell this story? A background in art college, web dev, consulting, product design... but not your average story in corporate America. Instead - a wide range of hands-on, fast-paced roles that lead to breadth and depth... I can already tell I'm over engineering it... ;)

officially-looking.title: Officially looking for a new long-term role
officially-looking.description: The search is on: a full-time senior product design role with a team I can invest in for the long haul.
officially-looking.summary: After spending 6+ years focusing on design and dev education - and consulting/contracting in parallel - I needed a bit of a break to recalibrate! Maybe I'll talk about some of those lessons - and how it felt to let the machine slow down -- but right now, I want to make it official. I'm on the hunt for my next long-term mission-driven team.
